title: [langgenius/dify] Fix issue #38790: Markdown table copy should include plain-text clipboard fallback
description:

Target:
Fix the Markdown table copy path so it still pastes into plain-text editors. The likely shape is keeping Markdown copy behavior while also writing a text/plain clipboard fallback instead of only text/markdown.

Required deliverables:

- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.
